message: 本日パイ高値を更新
The second day of midterms had come to an end.
With a spring in my step from that sense of freedom, I head to the Student Council room. No plans or regular meetings are scheduled, but I wonder if everyone's already there.
Sharing the joy of finishing our exams, comparing answers, complaining together, and teaching each other the problems we couldn't solve. I could easily picture everyone doing just that.

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, my?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai, I knew you'd be here. What about Misa, Nanaka, and Lolotte--」

name: Ria
message: 「Squeeze\s04 Gotcha, Synn-kun~~\s07」
Suddenly, Senpai grabbed one of my arms in a firm grip and led me downstairs.

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm~ Let's see, this one and this one... Oh, and those tea leaves over there look delicious too.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Pocketing nothing but top-shelf stuff, huh? Leave it to Ria-chan to have an eye for quality.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Isn't that straight-up theft?」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No it's not! We're sisters, so it's not stealing, it's just borrowing without asking!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm an only child so I wouldn't know, but... is that really how it works?」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee, yep, that's just how it works.」
Ria-senpai had brought me with her to the Chairwoman's office.
Unfortunately, Helena-san wasn't in, yet Ria-senpai rummaged through the cupboards and desk drawers as if she owned the place.
She even went so far as to uncover high-end traditional sweets hidden behind some books, handing them over to me one after another.

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis is the only person I'd ever do this to, okay?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Seeing this unexpected side of Ria-chan is making yours truly fall for her even harder.」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez, I'm only doing this because I have no choice--it's for my cute underclassmen starving up in the Student Council room.」

name: Synn
message: 「You sure look like you're having a blast for someone with 'no choice,' though?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha... Yep, that ought to do it.」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis, I'll be borrowing some black tea and sweets, okay?」

name: Ria
message: 「Alright boys, let's scram!」
With our arms full of both Western and traditional sweets, Senpai and I headed toward the door--

name: Helena
message: 「Poof~♪」

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, it's Helena\s04 Making a dazzling entrance in a puff of smoke, just like a ninja♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis, please obey the laws of physics in the Human World.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, I am obeying them, you know? This is Tamiko-chan's technique, after all.」

name: Helena
message: 「More importantly... Hmm-hmm, you certainly have a good eye for sweets.」

name: Helena
message: 「So, who's the ringleader?」

name: Paqy
message: 「This guy.」

name: Helena
message: 「Hmm, u-fu-fu.\s04」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gah... It was Ria-chan! S-Synn-sama is just an accomplice by willful negligence...」

name: Ria
message: 「Paa-chan, and here I trusted you!」

name: Paqy
message: 「S-Sorry... *gasp* I never expected to suffer this kind of torture on top of a billiard table.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, an eight-legged billiard table is a rare treasure, you know? Paa-chan is a lucky boy to get to feel so good right here.」

name: Paqy
message: 「A... Aaaaaah~! ...*thud*!」

name: Helena
message: 「Fufufufu, he's paid the price for perjury. Next up--」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Wait a minute! Ria-senpai only did it because she was thinking of everyone in the Student Council!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun...」

name: Ria
message: 「B-Big Sis, I'm the one at fault!」

name: Helena
message: 「That's right.」

name: Ria
message: 「Aha, ahahaha...」

name: Helena
message: 「Ria, what you're at fault for is feeling guilty about it, you know?」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm a Student Council alumna and your big sister, aren't I? Don't hold back--just take whatever you want.」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis...」

name: Helena
message: 「However... ufufu. Precisely because we're family, I'll have you pay me back in full, okay?」

name: Helena
message: 「Chocolates and cookies, rice crackers and caramels, kashiwa mochi...」

name: Helena
message: 「Let's see, converted at today's exchange rate, that comes out to roughly 1,427 boob-bucks.」

name: Ria
message: 「W-What kind of weird currency unit is that?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, you know full well what it is♪ You naughty girl, Ria~\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez, and I was actually moved for once. Hmph!」

name: Helena
message: 「Anyway, Synn-chan, you take the spoils and head back to the Student Council room ahead of us.」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way. I can't just leave you behind by yourself, Senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, don't worry about me... I'm counting on you to deliver everyone's snacks!」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, Big Sis! Grope me as much as you want!」

name: Helena
message: 「I like that spirit!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Actually, I've been getting interested in butts lately, too.」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh, whaaa...?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Apparently, in some regions, butt meat is called 'mochi flesh,' you know? Ufufufu, I wonder if Ria is nice and squishy?」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No... way... B-Big Sis, stop...」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'll be excusing myself now!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, wait! Help--」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh no, he cannot!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Here we go~♪ Poke-poke-poke-poke, grope-grope-grope-grope.\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Fwah?! Ah... kyau, nnh... whiiine.」
